evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每个班级平均退课率，退课去重学生除以该班选课去重学生，最后对班级求平均，返回两年平均退课率。
evidence.query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2024 GROUP BY class_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2024), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2025), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2025;

evidence.question: 计算2025年各股票的日均成交金额
evidence.query: SELECT s.stock_name, (SUM(t.volume * t.close_price) / COUNT(t.trade_id)) AS avg_daily_value FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name ORDER BY avg_daily_value DESC;

evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r2025.taxable - r2024.taxable) / r2024.taxable * 100) AS change_rate FROM (SELECT company_id, revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025) r2025 JOIN (SELECT company_id, revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2024) r2024 ON r2025.company_id = r2024.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r2025.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r2024.taxable > 0;

evidence.question: 请计算上汽集团2025年度所得税额占净利润的比例

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025两年中学期表里是否存在学期代码相同的记录，返回学期代码、2024是否存在、2025是否存在。
evidence.query: SELECT COALESCE(a.semester_code,b.semester_code) AS semester_code, CASE WHEN a.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code UNION SELECT b.semester_code, 0 AS exists_in_2024, 1 AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a ON a.semester_code=b.semester_code WHERE a.semester_code IS NULL;

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025两年共同存在的学生中，家庭地区编号在两年发生变化的学生数量。

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的班级编号，在学期一中选课人数，去重学号，差值前3，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH a2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, COALESCE(a2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024, 0) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024, COALESCE(a2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025, 0) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025, COALESCE(a2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(a2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 3;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程最高总评折算分的课程，返回两年都存在且最高分相等的课程数量。
evidence.query: WITH max2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total_2024 FROM max2024 GROUP BY course_id ), max2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total_2025 FROM max2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS courses_max_equal_cnt FROM agg2024 a JOIN agg2025 b ON b.course_id = a.course_id WHERE a.max_total_2024 = b.max_total_2025;

evidence.question: 统计电力企业各岗位类别的男女比例

evidence.question: 查询符合小型微利条件的民营企业数量占民营企业总数的比例
evidence.query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_private = TRUE;

evidence.question: 请计算中国石化2025年度所得税额占收入的比例
evidence.query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 / r.revenue) * 100 AS tax_burden FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国石化' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

evidence.question: 请计算上汽集团2025年度所得税额占净利润的比例
evidence.query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25) / (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 100 AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON r.company_id = f.company_id AND r.tax_year = 2025 JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '上汽集团' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

evidence.question: 查询符合小型微利条件的民营企业数量占民营企业总数的比例

evidence.question: 统计各年份成立的电力企业中目前仍在运营的比例

evidence.question: 查询各发电场站中装机容量占所属企业总装机容量的比例

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学生性别为女性的比例，即女性数除以总数，返回两年比例，以百分比表示并保留两位小数。

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025中在同一课程上选课，学期编号为1且排除退课，且总评不低于60的学生数差，即2025年减去2024年，按课程返回前10。
evidence.query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS pass_cnt_2024 FROM per2024 WHERE total_score>=30 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS pass_cnt_2025 FROM per2025 WHERE total_score>=30 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(agg2025.pass_cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(agg2024.pass_cnt_2024,0) AS pass_cnt_diff_2025_minus_2024, COALESCE(agg2024.pass_cnt_2024,0) AS pass_cnt_2024, COALESCE(agg2025.pass_cnt_2025,0) AS pass_cnt_2025 FROM agg2025 LEFT JOIN agg2024 ON agg2024.course_id=agg2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=agg2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_cnt_diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60%的课程数量，去重学号计算，返回两年数量。
evidence.query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ) SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2024 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60%的课程数量，去重学号计算，返回两年数量。
evidence.query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ) SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2024 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2025;

evidence.query: SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id ORDER BY active_enroll_cnt DESC, e.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均参与人数，去重学号后对课程求平均，返回两年平均值。
evidence.query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2024),2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2025),2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均分，按总评成绩计算，排除退课，再统计两年平均分差，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH avg2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, AVG( (CASE WHEN s.exam_item='平时' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期中' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期末' THEN s.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) ) AS avg_course_score_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score s ON s.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), avg2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, AVG( (CASE WHEN s.exam_item='平时' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期中' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期末' THEN s.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) ) AS avg_course_score_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score s ON s.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_course_score_2025) FROM avg2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_course_score_2024) FROM avg2024),2) AS diff_avg_course_score_2025_minus_2024;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计所有油轮（vessel_type=80）的数量
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS oil_tanker_count FROM transportation.vessel v JOIN common.vessel_type_dict vt ON v.vessel_type = vt.type_code WHERE vt.type_name = '油轮';

evidence.question: 统计各注册类型企业2025年平均扣除金额
evidence.query: SELECT rt.type_name, AVG(r.deductions) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY rt.type_name;

evidence.question: 统计各行业平均资产负债率
evidence.query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(f.total_liabilities / f.total_assets * 100) FROM finance_tax.company_financials f JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON f.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

evidence.question: 统计各电力企业可再生能源装机容量和员工数量的综合排名
evidence.query: SELECT ec.company_name, SUM(CASE WHEN et.is_renewable=1 THEN es.installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS renewable_capacity, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code LEFT JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name ORDER BY renewable_capacity DESC;

evidence.question: 按会员等级名称统计用户数量。
evidence.query: SELECT d.level_name, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM ecommerce.customer c JOIN common.customer_level_dict d ON c.level_code = d.level_code GROUP BY d.level_code, d.level_name ORDER BY d.level_code;

evidence.question: 按订单状态名称统计订单数量
evidence.query: SELECT d.status_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders o JOIN common.order_status_dict d ON o.order_status_code = d.status_code GROUP BY d.status_code, d.status_name ORDER BY d.status_code;

evidence.question: 统计各行业高新技术企业平均市净率

evidence.question: 查询股息率排名前三的股票

evidence.question: 统计各省份电力企业中总员工数量与总装机容量的比值排名

evidence.question: 统计各电力企业中总装机容量排名前5的企业及其员工数量
evidence.query: SELECT ec.company_name, SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS total_capacity, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id LEFT JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name ORDER BY total_capacity DESC LIMIT 5;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中课程类型为“必修”的选课人数，排除退课，并返回两年总人数。
evidence.query: SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(cnt) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.course_type='必修' GROUP BY e.course_id) t UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(cnt) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.course_type='必修' GROUP BY e.course_id) t;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均分，按总评成绩计算，排除退课，再统计两年平均分差，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH avg2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, AVG( (CASE WHEN s.exam_item='平时' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期中' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期末' THEN s.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) ) AS avg_course_score_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score s ON s.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), avg2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, AVG( (CASE WHEN s.exam_item='平时' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期中' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期末' THEN s.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) ) AS avg_course_score_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score s ON s.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_course_score_2025) FROM avg2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_course_score_2024) FROM avg2024),2) AS diff_avg_course_score_2025_minus_2024;

evidence.question: 统计学期表中学期编号不为0的记录数，并返回数量。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS semester_id_not_zero_cnt FROM education_2025.semester sem WHERE sem.semester_id<>0;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025教师工号的数量，不去重并按记录数，返回两年数量。

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每个院系选课人数排名前二的院系，返回院系编号与选课人数，去重学生，按选课人数降序取前2。
evidence.query: WITH dept_enroll AS (SELECT c.department_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.department_id) SELECT department_id, active_student_cnt FROM dept_enroll ORDER BY active_student_cnt DESC, department_id ASC LIMIT 2;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均分，按总评成绩计算，排除退课，再统计两年平均分差，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH avg2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, AVG( (CASE WHEN s.exam_item='平时' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期中' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期末' THEN s.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) ) AS avg_course_score_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score s ON s.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), avg2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, AVG( (CASE WHEN s.exam_item='平时' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期中' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期末' THEN s.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) ) AS avg_course_score_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score s ON s.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_course_score_2025) FROM avg2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_course_score_2024) FROM avg2024),2) AS diff_avg_course_score_2025_minus_2024;

evidence.question: 统计支付状态为SUCCESS的支付记录数量

evidence.question: 查询MMSI为417000002且航向大于270度的记录。

evidence.question: 统计2024与2025两年中起始日期键不低于20240101的学期中各自有效选课记录数，排除退课，返回两年有效选课记录数。
evidence.query: WITH sem2024 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101), sem2025 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101) SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2024) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2025);

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025教师表中电话去重后的数量，返回两年各自的去重电话数。
evidence.query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT phone) AS distinct_phone_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT phone) AS distinct_phone_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'';

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的退课率，退课去重学生除以选课去重学生，对所有班级求平均，返回两年平均退课率。
evidence.query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2024 GROUP BY class_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2024), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2025), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中退课率最高的排名第一的课程，退课去重学生数除以选课去重学生数，返回两年各自的课程编号与退课率。
evidence.query: WITH b2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2024 GROUP BY course_id ), b2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2024 r JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2025 r JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的退课率，退课去重学生除以选课去重学生，对所有班级求平均，返回两年平均退课率。
evidence.query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2024 GROUP BY class_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2024), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2025), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60的课程数量，按去重学生计算，返回两年数量。
evidence.query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ) SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN (pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0)) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2024 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN (pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0)) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2025;

evidence.question: 统计2024与2025两年中起始日期键不低于20240101的学期中各自有效选课记录数，排除退课，返回两年有效选课记录数。
evidence.query: WITH sem2024 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101), sem2025 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101) SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2024) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2025);

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的退课率，退课去重学生除以选课去重学生，对所有班级求平均，返回两年平均退课率。
evidence.query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2024 GROUP BY class_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2024), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2025), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中退课率最高的排名第一的课程，退课去重学生数除以选课去重学生数，返回两年各自的课程编号与退课率。

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60的课程数量，按去重学生计算，返回两年数量。

evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(((a2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt, 0)) - (a2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt, 0))) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_diff_pct, ROUND((a2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct, ROUND((a2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY pass_rate_diff_pct DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, (COALESCE(a2025.avg_total_2025,0)-COALESCE(a2024.avg_total_2024,0)) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024, a2024.avg_total_2024, a2025.avg_total_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程类型为必修的课程中，及格率最高的排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、课程名、两年及格率。
evidence.query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2024 GROUP BY course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id = p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.query: WITH sem2024 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101), sem2025 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101) SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2024) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2025);

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程类型为必修的课程中，及格率最高的排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、课程名、两年及格率。
evidence.query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2024 GROUP BY course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id = p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程类型为必修的课程中，及格率最高的排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、课程名、两年及格率。
evidence.query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2024 GROUP BY course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id = p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 查询MMSI为412000123的船舶最新位置周围3公里内，航行状态为锚泊的其他船舶。
evidence.query: WITH target_pos AS (SELECT geom FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 412000123 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.mmsi) v.* FROM vessel_ais_data v, target_pos t WHERE v.mmsi != 412000123 AND v.nav_status = 1 AND ST_DWithin(v.geom::geography, t.geom::geography, 3000) ORDER BY v.mmsi, v.timestamp DESC

evidence.question: 统计北京市各车型的新能源车辆数量

evidence.question: 请计算美的集团2025年度应纳所得税额
evidence.query: SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 AS tax_payable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '美的集团' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

evidence.question: 请计算上汽集团2025年度所得税额占净利润的比例
evidence.query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25) / (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 100 AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON r.company_id = f.company_id AND r.tax_year = 2025 JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '上汽集团' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

evidence.question: 统计每个公司车辆保险已过期的数量
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(v.vehicle_id) AS expired_count FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id WHERE v.insurance_expire < CURDATE() GROUP BY c.company_id;

evidence.question: 查询所有驾照即将在6个月内过期的驾驶员
evidence.query: SELECT name, DATE_ADD(issue_date, INTERVAL valid_years YEAR) AS expire_date FROM transportation.driver WHERE DATE_ADD(issue_date, INTERVAL valid_years YEAR) BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH);

evidence.question: 查询河南省所有保险在半年内到期的车辆
evidence.query: SELECT plate_number, insurance_expire FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '41%' AND insurance_expire BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 180 DAY);

evidence.question: 统计各电力企业资质即将在半年内到期的数量

evidence.question: 计算当前时刻（以最新数据为准）MMSI为351000001与MMSI为412000111两船之间的距离，并判断是否小于5公里。
evidence.query: WITH s1 AS (SELECT geom FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 351000001 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1), s2 AS (SELECT geom FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 412000111 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ST_Distance(s1.geom::geography, s2.geom::geography) AS distance, ST_DWithin(s1.geom::geography, s2.geom::geography, 5000) AS within_5km FROM s1, s2

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号对应课程数差值前3，按差值绝对值降序，返回院系编号与两年课程数、差值。
evidence.query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id), diff AS (SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id,c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS cnt_2024, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0) AS cnt_2025, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2025 LEFT JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=c2025.department_id UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id,c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS cnt_2024, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0) AS cnt_2025, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2024 LEFT JOIN c2025 ON c2025.department_id=c2024.department_id WHERE c2025.department_id IS NULL) SELECT department_id, cnt_2024, cnt_2025, diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM (SELECT * FROM diff ORDER BY ABS(diff_2025_minus_2024) DESC, department_id ASC) t LIMIT 3;

evidence.query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no), ranked AS (SELECT p.course_id, p.student_no, p.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id ORDER BY p.total_score ASC, p.student_no ASC) AS rn FROM per_enroll p) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, r.student_no FROM ranked r JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE r.rn=1 ORDER BY c.course_id ASC;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较不同企业注册类型的平均企业所得税税额
evidence.query: SELECT rt.type_name, AVG((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) AS avg_tax FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY rt.type_name ORDER BY avg_tax DESC;

evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二每班级平均及格率，总评不低于60并排除退课，先班级后平均，返回两年平均班级及格率。
evidence.query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT student_id), 0)) * 100 AS class_pass_rate_pct FROM per2024 GROUP BY class_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT student_id), 0)) * 100 AS class_pass_rate_pct FROM per2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(agg2024.class_pass_rate_pct), 2) AS avg_class_pass_rate_pct_2024, ROUND(AVG(agg2025.class_pass_rate_pct), 2) AS avg_class_pass_rate_pct_2025 FROM agg2024 CROSS JOIN agg2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均参与人数，去重学号后对课程求平均，返回两年平均值。
evidence.query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2024),2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2025),2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均总评折算分，排除退课，并返回两年平均值之差，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2025) FROM a2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2024) FROM a2024),2) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二每班级平均及格率，总评不低于60并排除退课，先班级后平均，返回两年平均班级及格率。

evidence.question: 比较各行业小型微利企业与高新技术企业的所得税优惠总额
evidence.query: SELECT i.industry_name, SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.05 WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 ELSE 0 END) AS tax_benefit FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY i.industry_name;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的平均参与人数，去重学号，先对班级统计再对班级取平均，返回两年平均值。
evidence.query: WITH p2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), p2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2024), 2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_class_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2025), 2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_class_2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均退课人数，去重学号，返回两年各自平均值，对课程求均值。
evidence.query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(withdraw_cnt),2) FROM w2024) AS avg_withdraw_cnt_per_course_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(withdraw_cnt),2) FROM w2025) AS avg_withdraw_cnt_per_course_2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均总评折算分，排除退课，并返回两年平均值之差，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2025) FROM a2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2024) FROM a2024),2) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的平均参与人数，去重学号，先对班级统计再对班级取平均，返回两年平均值。

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025两年中学期表里是否存在学期代码相同的记录，返回学期代码、2024是否存在、2025是否存在。
evidence.query: SELECT COALESCE(a.semester_code,b.semester_code) AS semester_code, CASE WHEN a.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code UNION SELECT b.semester_code, 0 AS exists_in_2024, 1 AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a ON a.semester_code=b.semester_code WHERE a.semester_code IS NULL;

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025中课程名包含“数据库”的课程，在两年里是否都存在，返回课程名、2024是否存在、2025是否存在。
evidence.query: WITH c2024 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_id, course_name FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数据库%' ), c2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_id, course_name FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数据库%' ) SELECT COALESCE(a.course_id, b.course_id) AS course_id, COALESCE(a.course_name, b.course_name) AS course_name, CASE WHEN a.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM c2024 a LEFT JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_id = a.course_id UNION SELECT COALESCE(a.course_id, b.course_id) AS course_id, COALESCE(a.course_name, b.course_name) AS course_name, CASE WHEN a.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM c2024 a RIGHT JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_id = a.course_id WHERE a.course_id IS NULL;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025两年中学期表里是否存在学期代码相同的记录，返回学期代码、2024是否存在、2025是否存在。
evidence.query: SELECT COALESCE(a.semester_code,b.semester_code) AS semester_code, CASE WHEN a.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code UNION SELECT b.semester_code, 0 AS exists_in_2024, 1 AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a ON a.semester_code=b.semester_code WHERE a.semester_code IS NULL;

evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计各行业高新技术企业平均市净率
evidence.query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS avg_pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025两年中学期表里是否存在学期代码相同的记录，返回学期代码、2024是否存在、2025是否存在。
evidence.query: SELECT COALESCE(a.semester_code,b.semester_code) AS semester_code, CASE WHEN a.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code UNION SELECT b.semester_code, 0 AS exists_in_2024, 1 AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a ON a.semester_code=b.semester_code WHERE a.semester_code IS NULL;

evidence.question: 计算各企业2025年度的实际税负率，列出实际税负率低于15%的企业
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.revenue) * 100 AS effective_rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 HAVING effective_rate < 15;

evidence.question: 统计船舶公司各员工类型的人数

evidence.question: 查询国有企业2025年平均应纳税所得额
evidence.query: SELECT AVG(r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND rt.type_name = '国有独资公司';

evidence.question: 查询属于“商务服务业”且为小型的企业的名称及规模
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, s.size_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code WHERE i.industry_name = '商务服务业' AND s.size_name = '小型';

evidence.question: 哪个行业的小型微利企业数量最多？
evidence.query: SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 统计各电力企业可再生能源装机容量占比
evidence.query: SELECT ec.company_name, SUM(CASE WHEN et.is_renewable=1 THEN es.installed_capacity ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS renewable_pct FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name HAVING SUM(es.installed_capacity) > 0;

evidence.question: 列出不属于小型微利企业的高新技术企业名单及其应纳税所得额
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable_income FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND NOT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE);

evidence.question: 查询“贵州茅台”的应纳税所得额及应纳所得税额
evidence.query: SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable_income, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.15 AS tax_payable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON c.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '贵州茅台' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

evidence.question: 统计各行业高新技术企业平均市净率
evidence.query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS avg_pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60%的课程数量，去重学号计算，返回两年数量。
evidence.query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ) SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2024 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2025;

evidence.question: 比较各行业小型微利企业与高新技术企业的所得税优惠总额

evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.total_assets) * 100 AS contribution FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY contribution DESC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的平均参与人数，去重学号，先对班级统计再对班级取平均，返回两年平均值。
evidence.query: WITH p2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), p2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2024), 2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_class_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2025), 2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_class_2025;

evidence.query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(withdraw_cnt),2) FROM w2024) AS avg_withdraw_cnt_per_course_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(withdraw_cnt),2) FROM w2025) AS avg_withdraw_cnt_per_course_2025;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均总评折算分，排除退课，并返回两年平均值之差，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2025) FROM a2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2024) FROM a2024),2) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024;

evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2025) FROM a2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2024) FROM a2024),2) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的班级数，按班级编号，并计算共同班级中性别不同的学生数，去重学号。
evidence.query: WITH common_classes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s2024.class_id FROM education_2024.enrollment e2024 JOIN education_2024.student s2024 ON s2024.student_id = e2024.student_id JOIN education_2025.enrollment e2025 ON e2025.student_id = e2024.student_id AND e2025.semester_id = e2024.semester_id JOIN education_2025.student s2025 ON s2025.student_id = e2025.student_id AND s2025.class_id = s2024.class_id ), common_students AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s2024.student_id, s2024.gender_code AS gender_2024, s2025.gender_code AS gender_2025 FROM education_2024.enrollment e2024 JOIN education_2024.student s2024 ON s2024.student_id = e2024.student_id JOIN education_2025.enrollment e2025 ON e2025.student_id = e2024.student_id AND e2025.semester_id = e2024.semester_id JOIN education_2025.student s2025 ON s2025.student_id = e2025.student_id WHERE s2024.class_id = s2025.class_id ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM common_classes) AS common_class_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gender_2024, '') <> COALESCE(gender_2025, '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gender_diff_common_student_cnt FROM common_students;

evidence.question: 计算2024与2025中课程学分为3的数量差，即2025年减去2024年，返回差值及两年数量。

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60%的课程数量，去重学号计算，返回两年数量。

evidence.question: 计算各企业2025年度的所得税贡献率
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.total_assets) * 100 AS contribution FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY contribution DESC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中退课率最低的排名第一的课程，退课率等于退课去重人数除以选课去重人数，返回两年各自退课率最低课程。
evidence.query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt FROM base2024 GROUP BY course_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt FROM base2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a.withdraw_student_cnt / NULLIF(a.total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM agg2024 a JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a.withdraw_student_cnt / NULLIF(a.total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM agg2025 a JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程最低总评折算分对应的学生学号，若并列取学号最小，返回课程编号、课程名与学号。
