evidence.query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt FROM base2024 GROUP BY course_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt FROM base2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a.withdraw_student_cnt / NULLIF(a.total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM agg2024 a JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a.withdraw_student_cnt / NULLIF(a.total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM agg2025 a JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

evidence.question: 统计各行业高新技术企业平均市净率
evidence.query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS avg_pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

evidence.question: 统计各行业高新技术企业平均市净率

evidence.question: 比较各行业小型微利企业与高新技术企业的所得税优惠总额
evidence.query: SELECT i.industry_name, SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.05 WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 ELSE 0 END) AS tax_benefit FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY i.industry_name;

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025两年中学期表里是否存在学期代码相同的记录，返回学期代码、2024是否存在、2025是否存在。
evidence.query: SELECT COALESCE(a.semester_code,b.semester_code) AS semester_code, CASE WHEN a.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code UNION SELECT b.semester_code, 0 AS exists_in_2024, 1 AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a ON a.semester_code=b.semester_code WHERE a.semester_code IS NULL;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的学生，学号相同，性别不同的学生数量。
evidence.query: WITH common_students AS (SELECT a.student_id, a.gender_code AS gender_2024, b.gender_code AS gender_2025 FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_student_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gender_2024,'')<>COALESCE(gender_2025,'') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gender_diff_in_common_cnt FROM common_students;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025中同名课程，课程名相同，返回仅存在2024、仅存在2025、两年都存在的数量。
evidence.query: WITH c2024 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_name FROM education_2024.course ), c2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_name FROM education_2025.course ), both_courses AS ( SELECT a.course_name FROM c2024 a JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_name = a.course_name ), only2024 AS ( SELECT a.course_name FROM c2024 a LEFT JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_name = a.course_name WHERE b.course_name IS NULL ), only2025 AS ( SELECT b.course_name FROM c2025 b LEFT JOIN c2024 a ON a.course_name = b.course_name WHERE a.course_name IS NULL ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM only2024) AS only_2024_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM only2025) AS only_2025_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both_courses) AS both_cnt;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回平均分最高的班级在两年中的差值，即2025减2024，取班级编号相同者。
evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025 - a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回平均分最高的班级在两年中的差值，即2025减2024，取班级编号相同者。

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回平均分最高的班级在两年中的差值，即2025减2024，取班级编号相同者。
evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025 - a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 查询所有船首向（heading）与对地航向（cog）完全相同（差值=0）的船舶

evidence.question: 查询国有企业2025年平均应纳税所得额
evidence.query: SELECT AVG(r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND rt.type_name = '国有独资公司';

evidence.question: 查询属于“商务服务业”且为小型的企业的名称及规模
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, s.size_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code WHERE i.industry_name = '商务服务业' AND s.size_name = '小型';

evidence.question: 哪个行业的小型微利企业数量最多？
evidence.query: SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 统计各省级行政区电力企业中清洁能源装机容量占比超过50%的省份
evidence.query: SELECT LEFT(es.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN et.category='清洁能源' THEN es.installed_capacity ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS clean_pct FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code GROUP BY LEFT(es.area_id,2) HAVING clean_pct > 50;

evidence.question: 查询2025年应纳税所得额超过500万元的民营企业
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_private = TRUE AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) > 500;

evidence.question: 查询“贵州茅台”的应纳税所得额及应纳所得税额
evidence.query: SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable_income, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.15 AS tax_payable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON c.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '贵州茅台' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

evidence.question: 按股息率从高到低排列所有股票,使用当日收盘价
evidence.query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / t.close_price * 100 AS dividend_yield FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY dividend_yield DESC;

evidence.question: 请计算宁德时代2025年度净利润和应纳所得税额
evidence.query: SELECT (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) AS net_profit, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.15 AS tax_payable FROM finance_tax.company_financials f JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r ON f.company_id = r.company_id AND r.tax_year = 2025 JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON f.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '宁德时代' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

evidence.question: 查询2025年应纳税所得额最高的企业名称及其应纳税所得额
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY taxable DESC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.course_id) AS taught_course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.course_id) AS taught_course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT (b.taught_course_cnt_2025-a.taught_course_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.taught_course_cnt_2024, b.taught_course_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025两年中同一班级编号对应的课程平均学分差，对该班级选修课程学分的平均并排除退课，返回班级编号与学分差前10，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY class_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_credit_2024, 2) AS avg_credit_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_credit_2025, 2) AS avg_credit_2025, ROUND((a2025.avg_credit_2025 - a2024.avg_credit_2024), 2) AS diff_avg_credit_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_avg_credit_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no), ranked AS (SELECT p.course_id, p.student_no, p.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id ORDER BY p.total_score ASC, p.student_no ASC) AS rn FROM per_enroll p) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, r.student_no FROM ranked r JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE r.rn=1 ORDER BY c.course_id ASC;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025在同一课程编号上通过率，总评不低于60，返回通过率最高的排名第一的课程在两年各自的课程编号与通过率。
evidence.query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), passrate2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS total_enroll_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN enrollment_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_enroll_cnt FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), passrate2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS total_enroll_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN enrollment_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_enroll_cnt FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_enroll_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_enroll_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM passrate2024 p JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_enroll_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_enroll_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM passrate2025 p JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每个班级的平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回2025与2024差值最大的排名第一的班级，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025 - a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程类型为必修的课程中，及格率最高的排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、课程名、两年及格率。
evidence.query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2024 GROUP BY course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id = p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 查询学期编号为1中选课人数排名第一的课程，返回课程编号与课程名。
evidence.query: SELECT x.course_id, x.course_name FROM (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name) x ORDER BY x.cnt DESC, x.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025 - a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.query: WITH base2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(CASE WHEN e.is_withdraw=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keep_flag FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), base2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c2025.course_id, ROUND((a2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_pct_2025, ROUND((a2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_pct_2024 FROM agg2025 a2025 JOIN agg2024 a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c2025 ON c2025.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY (a2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt,0)-a2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt,0)) DESC, c2025.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60%的课程数量，去重学号计算，返回两年数量。
evidence.query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ) SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2024 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2025;

evidence.query: WITH b2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2024 GROUP BY course_id ), b2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2024 r JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2025 r JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号在两年都存在的部门，返回这些院系编号及两年课程数差值，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id) SELECT c2025.department_id, c2024.cnt_2024, c2025.cnt_2025, c2025.cnt_2025-c2024.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2025 JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=c2025.department_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c2025.department_id ASC;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中退课记录数，不去重，按选课记录行，差值前3课程，即2025减2024，返回课程编号、两年退课行数、差值。
evidence.query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_rows_2024,0) AS withdraw_rows_2024, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_rows_2025,0) AS withdraw_rows_2025, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_rows_2025,0)-COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_rows_2024,0) AS diff_withdraw_rows_2025_minus_2024 FROM w2025 LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id=w2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=w2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_withdraw_rows_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 3;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分的中位数，返回两年中位数。
evidence.query: WITH ranked2024 AS (SELECT credit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY credit) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM education_2024.course), ranked2025 AS (SELECT credit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY credit) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM education_2025.course) SELECT (SELECT AVG(credit) FROM ranked2024 WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2))) AS median_credit_2024, (SELECT AVG(credit) FROM ranked2025 WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2))) AS median_credit_2025;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 查询院系编号为2的班级中班级名称包含“计”的班级列表，返回班级编号与名称并按班级编号升序取前20。

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
evidence.query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分的中位数，返回两年中位数。

evidence.question: 统计2024与2025两年中起始日期键不低于20240101的学期中各自有效选课记录数，排除退课，返回两年有效选课记录数。
evidence.query: WITH sem2024 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101), sem2025 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101) SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2024) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2025);

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
evidence.query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学生性别为女性的比例，即女性数除以总数，返回两年比例，以百分比表示并保留两位小数。

evidence.question: 按订单状态名称统计订单数量，返回查询结果。
evidence.query: SELECT d.status_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders o JOIN common.order_status_dict d ON o.order_status_code = d.status_code GROUP BY d.status_code, d.status_name ORDER BY d.status_code;

evidence.question: 按支付方式名称统计支付金额，返回查询结果。
evidence.query: SELECT d.method_name, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_amount), 2) AS pay_amount FROM ecommerce.payment p JOIN common.payment_method_dict d ON p.payment_method_code = d.method_code GROUP BY d.method_code, d.method_name ORDER BY d.method_code;

evidence.question: 统计各平台订单数量，返回查询结果。
evidence.query: SELECT d.platform_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders o JOIN common.platform_dict d ON o.platform_code = d.platform_code GROUP BY d.platform_code, d.platform_name ORDER BY d.platform_code;

evidence.question: 统计各公司驾驶员的平均驾龄，驾龄按领证日期计算
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, d.issue_date, CURDATE())) AS avg_experience FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.driver d ON c.company_id = d.company_id GROUP BY c.company_id;

evidence.question: 查询所有驾驶员的姓名和驾龄，驾龄按领证日期计算
evidence.query: SELECT name, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, issue_date, CURDATE()) AS driving_years FROM transportation.driver;

evidence.question: 统计2019年至2023年期间每年注册的车辆数量
evidence.query: SELECT YEAR(register_date) AS year, COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE YEAR(register_date) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY YEAR(register_date) ORDER BY year;

evidence.question: 查询最大航速小于12节且自持力小于20天的船舶，在2024年6月1日08:00至12:00期间出现在(120.8, 30.5)周围8公里范围内的记录。
evidence.query: SELECT mmsi FROM transportation.vessel WHERE max_speed < 12 AND endurance < 20

evidence.question: 查询2025年报表日期为2025-03-31的企业名称

evidence.question: 查询所有B股股票的上市日期

evidence.question: 查询每只股票的历史最高收盘价及对应日期

evidence.question: 查询2025年报表日期为2025-03-31的企业名称

evidence.question: 查询所有电力企业中成立日期早于2000年的企业名称

evidence.question: 查询各电力企业中资质在半年内到期的企业名称和到期日期

evidence.question: 查询各发电场站中属于十四五期间投产的场站名称和并网日期

evidence.question: 查询所有电力企业员工的姓名、出生日期和年龄

evidence.question: 查询所有院系，返回院系编号与院系名称，并按院系编号升序取前20条。
evidence.query: SELECT d.department_id, d.department_name FROM education_2024.department d ORDER BY d.department_id ASC LIMIT 20;

evidence.question: 查询电话为空的教师数量。

evidence.question: 查询院系编号为1的班级数量，并返回数量。

evidence.question: 查询2024与2025中课程类型为“选修”的课程数量，并返回两年数量。
evidence.query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修';

evidence.question: 统计2024与2025两年中起始日期键不低于20240101的学期中各自有效选课记录数，排除退课，返回两年有效选课记录数。
evidence.query: WITH sem2024 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101), sem2025 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101) SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2024) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2025);

evidence.question: 查询院系编号为4的教师姓名，按姓名升序取前25。
evidence.query: SELECT t.teacher_name FROM education_2025.teacher t WHERE t.department_id=4 ORDER BY t.teacher_name ASC LIMIT 25;

evidence.question: 查询院系编号为1的班级数量，并返回数量。

evidence.question: 查询院系编号为6的课程数量，并返回数量。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_dept6 FROM education_2025.course c WHERE c.department_id=6;

evidence.question: 统计2024与2025两年中起始日期键不低于20240101的学期中各自有效选课记录数，排除退课，返回两年有效选课记录数。
evidence.query: WITH sem2024 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101), sem2025 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101) SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2024) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2025);

evidence.question: 查询学期一中各课程的最高总评折算分不低于90的课程数量，并返回数量。
evidence.query: WITH per_student AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), per_course_max AS ( SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total_score FROM per_student GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_with_max_total_score_ge_90 FROM per_course_max WHERE max_total_score >= 90;

evidence.question: 查询会员等级为DIAMOND的用户，返回查询结果。

evidence.question: 统计支付状态为SUCCESS的支付记录数量，返回查询结果。

evidence.query: SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.brand = '解放' AND t.type_name='货车';

evidence.question: 查询长航集团旗下最大载重小于5万吨的船舶，在距离点(120.8,30.5)10公里内的AIS数据中按吃水深度降序取3条。

evidence.question: 查询所有货船（vessel_type=70）的MMSI和最大载重

evidence.question: 查询每个车辆公司拥有的车辆中，最大载重和最小载重

evidence.question: 查询所有驾驶员中，驾龄超过20年的驾驶员
evidence.query: SELECT name, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, issue_date, CURDATE()) AS experience FROM transportation.driver WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, issue_date, CURDATE()) > 20;

evidence.question: 统计所有车辆的最大载重、最小载重、总载重

evidence.question: 统计每个船舶公司的船舶最大载重总和
