evidence.question: 统计每个船舶公司的船舶最大载重总和
evidence.query: SELECT sc.company_name, SUM(v.max_load) AS total_load_capacity FROM transportation.shipping_company sc JOIN transportation.vessel v ON sc.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY sc.company_id ORDER BY total_load_capacity DESC;

evidence.question: 查询注册资本超过5000万元的民营企业
evidence.query: SELECT company_name, registered_capital FROM finance_tax.companies WHERE registered_capital > 5000 AND is_private = TRUE;

evidence.question: 查询所有上市超过5年的股票
evidence.query: SELECT stock_name, listing_date FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE listing_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 YEAR);

evidence.question: 查询2024年12月31日成交量最大的前10支股票
evidence.query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.volume FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date = '2024-12-31' ORDER BY t.volume DESC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计2025年现金分红总额超过1亿元的企业数量
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.company_financials WHERE report_date = '2025-12-31' AND dividend_cash > 10000;

evidence.question: 查询2025年度员工人数超过1000人的企业
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, r.employee_count FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.employee_count > 1000;

evidence.question: 查询所有电力企业中员工数量超过1000人的企业名称
evidence.query: SELECT company_name, staff_count FROM energy.energy_company WHERE staff_count > 1000;

evidence.question: 统计各电力企业中资质种类超过2种的企业名称和资质数量
evidence.query: SELECT ec.company_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cert_type) AS cert_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.company_certification cc ON ec.company_id = cc.company_id GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cert_type) > 2;

evidence.question: 统计武汉市发电场站中年发电量超过100000万kWh的数量
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_gen_count FROM energy.energy_station WHERE area_id LIKE '4201%' AND annual_generation > 100000;

evidence.question: 统计宁波市供电区域中供电户数超过100万的数量
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS large_area_count FROM energy.supply_area WHERE area_id LIKE '3302%' AND household_count > 1000000;

evidence.question: 查询所有电力企业中女性员工占比超过30%的企业名称
evidence.query: SELECT ec.company_name, SUM(CASE WHEN e.gender='女' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS female_pct FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name HAVING female_pct > 30;

evidence.question: 统计2024与2025学期表中结束日期键最大的10个学期代码在两年是否都存在，返回在两年都存在的数量。
evidence.query: WITH top2024 AS (SELECT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_date_key DESC, semester_code ASC LIMIT 10), top2025 AS (SELECT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_date_key DESC, semester_code ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_top10_end_date_semester_code_cnt FROM top2024 a JOIN top2025 b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每个班级的平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回2025与2024差值最大的排名第一的班级，即2025减2024。
evidence.query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025 - a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程编号最小值与最大值，返回两年最小值与最大值。
evidence.query: SELECT '2024' AS year, MIN(course_id) AS min_course_id, MAX(course_id) AS max_course_id FROM education_2024.course UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, MIN(course_id) AS min_course_id, MAX(course_id) AS max_course_id FROM education_2025.course;

evidence.question: 统计2024与2025学期一中每门课程平均总评折算分，并返回差值，即2025减2024，最大的前10门课程。

evidence.question: 找出2024与2025中在同一课程上选课，学期编号为1且排除退课，且总评不低于60的学生数差，即2025年减去2024年，按课程返回前10。
evidence.query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS pass_cnt_2024 FROM per2024 WHERE total_score>=30 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS pass_cnt_2025 FROM per2025 WHERE total_score>=30 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(agg2025.pass_cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(agg2024.pass_cnt_2024,0) AS pass_cnt_diff_2025_minus_2024, COALESCE(agg2024.pass_cnt_2024,0) AS pass_cnt_2024, COALESCE(agg2025.pass_cnt_2025,0) AS pass_cnt_2025 FROM agg2025 LEFT JOIN agg2024 ON agg2024.course_id=agg2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=agg2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_cnt_diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号对应课程数差值前3，按差值绝对值降序，返回院系编号与两年课程数、差值。
evidence.query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id), diff AS (SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id,c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS cnt_2024, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0) AS cnt_2025, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2025 LEFT JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=c2025.department_id UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id,c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS cnt_2024, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0) AS cnt_2025, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2024 LEFT JOIN c2025 ON c2025.department_id=c2024.department_id WHERE c2025.department_id IS NULL) SELECT department_id, cnt_2024, cnt_2025, diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM (SELECT * FROM diff ORDER BY ABS(diff_2025_minus_2024) DESC, department_id ASC) t LIMIT 3;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的选课去重学生数前3，按2025人数降序，返回两年各自前3对应班级的班级编号与人数。

evidence.question: 比较不同企业注册类型的平均企业所得税税额
evidence.query: SELECT rt.type_name, AVG((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) AS avg_tax FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY rt.type_name ORDER BY avg_tax DESC;

evidence.question: 比较不同企业注册类型的平均企业所得税税额

evidence.question: 统计各发电场站类型的员工平均年龄

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码按去重后共同的数量。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_semester_code_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师工号最小的教师姓名，若两年不同返回两年各自的最小教师信息。
evidence.query: (SELECT '2024' AS year, teacher_no, teacher_name FROM education_2024.teacher ORDER BY teacher_no ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, teacher_no, teacher_name FROM education_2025.teacher ORDER BY teacher_no ASC LIMIT 1);

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的学生，学号相同，性别不同的学生数量。
evidence.query: WITH common_students AS (SELECT a.student_id, a.gender_code AS gender_2024, b.gender_code AS gender_2025 FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_student_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gender_2024,'')<>COALESCE(gender_2025,'') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gender_diff_in_common_cnt FROM common_students;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同课程里学分不同的课程数量，并返回数量。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) AS common_courses_credit_diff_cnt FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id WHERE a.credit<>b.credit;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程选择记录中不同教师编号的数量，假设通过课程表教师编号，返回两年数量与差值。
evidence.query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.teacher_id) AS distinct_teacher_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.teacher_id) AS distinct_teacher_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT (b.distinct_teacher_cnt_2025-a.distinct_teacher_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.distinct_teacher_cnt_2024, b.distinct_teacher_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

evidence.question: 统计学期一中每门课程最低总评折算分对应的学生学号，若并列取学号最小，返回课程编号、课程名与学号。
evidence.query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no), ranked AS (SELECT p.course_id, p.student_no, p.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id ORDER BY p.total_score ASC, p.student_no ASC) AS rn FROM per_enroll p) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, r.student_no FROM ranked r JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE r.rn=1 ORDER BY c.course_id ASC;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码按去重后共同的数量。

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同课程里学分不同的课程数量，并返回数量。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) AS common_courses_credit_diff_cnt FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id WHERE a.credit<>b.credit;

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程选择记录中不同教师编号的数量，假设通过课程表教师编号，返回两年数量与差值。
evidence.query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.teacher_id) AS distinct_teacher_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.teacher_id) AS distinct_teacher_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT (b.distinct_teacher_cnt_2025-a.distinct_teacher_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.distinct_teacher_cnt_2024, b.distinct_teacher_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

evidence.question: 查询学期一中每门课程的最高总评折算分对应的学生学号，若并列取学号最小，返回课程编号、课程名与学号。
evidence.query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, s.student_no, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, s.student_no), ranked AS (SELECT p.course_id, p.student_no, p.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id ORDER BY p.total_score DESC, p.student_no ASC) AS rn FROM per_enroll p) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, r.student_no FROM ranked r JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE r.rn=1 ORDER BY c.course_id ASC;

evidence.question: 计算2024与2025中课程学分为3的数量差，即2025年减去2024年，返回差值及两年数量。

evidence.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程最高总评折算分的课程前3，各自前3，然后把两年的结果合并并标注年份，返回最多6行。
evidence.query: (WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), max2024 AS (SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(m.max_total,2) AS max_total_score FROM max2024 m JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=m.course_id ORDER BY max_total_score DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (WITH per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), max2025 AS (SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(m.max_total,2) AS max_total_score FROM max2025 m JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=m.course_id ORDER BY max_total_score DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 3);

evidence.question: 计算各企业2025年实际税负率，找出税负率最低的前三名
evidence.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / NULLIF(r.revenue,0)) AS tax_burden FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY tax_burden LIMIT 3;

evidence.query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

evidence.question: 统计2024与2025学期一中每门课程平均总评折算分，并返回差值，即2025减2024，最大的前10门课程。
evidence.query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, (COALESCE(a2025.avg_total_2025,0)-COALESCE(a2024.avg_total_2024,0)) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024, a2024.avg_total_2024, a2025.avg_total_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS new_energy_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.company_certification cc ON ec.company_id = cc.company_id WHERE LEFT(ec.area_id,2) IN ('50','51','52','53','54','61','62','63','64','65') AND cc.cert_type = '新能源类电力业务许可证';

evidence.question: 统计西部地区电力企业中拥有新能源类电力业务许可证的企业数量

evidence.question: 统计西部地区各省份新能源发电场站的装机容量占比
evidence.query: SELECT LEFT(es.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN et.is_renewable=1 THEN es.installed_capacity ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS renewable_pct FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code WHERE LEFT(es.area_id,2) IN ('50','51','52','53','54','61','62','63','64','65') GROUP BY LEFT(es.area_id,2);

evidence.question: 统计京津冀地区的总供电户数

evidence.question: 统计四川省电力企业中管理岗位员工的平均年龄
evidence.query: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, CURDATE())) AS avg_age FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id JOIN common.energy_position_dict ep ON e.position_code = ep.position_code WHERE ec.area_id LIKE '51%' AND ep.category = '管理';

evidence.question: 统计所有学期记录数量。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS semester_cnt FROM education_2024.semester sem;

evidence.question: 统计教师中女性人数。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_teacher_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher t WHERE t.gender_code='F';

evidence.question: 统计课程学分不低于3.5的课程数量。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_cnt FROM education_2024.course c WHERE c.credit >= 3.5;

evidence.question: 统计学期编号为1的有效选课记录数，排除退课。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0;

evidence.question: 统计2024与2025学期一中每门课程平均总评折算分，并返回差值，即2025减2024，最大的前10门课程。
evidence.query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, (COALESCE(a2025.avg_total_2025,0)-COALESCE(a2024.avg_total_2024,0)) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024, a2024.avg_total_2024, a2025.avg_total_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

evidence.question: 统计学期表中学期编号不为0的记录数，并返回数量。
evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS semester_id_not_zero_cnt FROM education_2025.semester sem WHERE sem.semester_id<>0;

evidence.question: 统计教师中电话不为空的数量，并返回数量。

evidence.question: 统计课程表中平均学分，保留两位小数，并返回平均值。

evidence.question: 统计每个用户的订单数量，输出结果。
evidence.query: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.customer c LEFT JOIN ecommerce.orders o   ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

evidence.question: 统计每个商品的销量。
evidence.query: SELECT p.product_id, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS sales_quantity FROM ecommerce.product p LEFT JOIN ecommerce.order_item oi   ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY p.product_id;

evidence.question: 统计整体退款率。
evidence.query: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.refund_amount > 0 THEN o.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM ecommerce.orders o LEFT JOIN ecommerce.order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id;

evidence.question: 查询今天在(121.0, 31.0)周围20公里内且航向在0至90度之间的船舶，从中筛选出最大航速超过20节的MMSI。
evidence.query: SELECT DISTINCT mmsi FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE AND cog BETWEEN 0 AND 90 AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(121.0, 31.0), 4326)::geography, 20000)
